blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jema Galanza credits Creamline’s hot start in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series to the Cool Smashers enjoying every game together and making the most of their opportunities. Galanza stood out in another Creamline balanced attack with 16 points and 11 excellent receptions, as Creamline outlasted Capital1, 25-18, 31-29, 25-16, for a 4-0 record on Thursday night at Santiago Sports Arena in Isabela. “I’m really happy because everyone is performing and contributing. I always say in interviews that everyone deserves to play, so I think this season is really an opportunity for everyone to show what they […]...
